target.title: Explain the browse-root boundary and link to Settings

scenario.action: Cold-open Add project → Open local folder at configured root
scenario.expected: Canonical root path, explanation and Settings link; no Up
scenario.observed: Root path and hint visible; no Up; useful shell/loading appeared before data

scenario.expected: Up below root, hint absent below root and restored at root
scenario.observed: Nested listing shows Up; returning to absolute root restores hint

scenario.action: Activate Settings link with keyboard and a direct mouse click
scenario.expected: Settings → Projects opens and picker dismisses
scenario.observed: URL /settings/global/projects, Default browse folder textbox visible, picker absent

scenario.action: Repeat root picker at 390 × 844 viewport with long canonical path
scenario.expected: Hint/link wrap; no horizontal overflow or missing controls
scenario.observed: Readable wrapped hint, truncated path, visible Cancel/Add controls

scenario.expected: Existing empty-folder guidance and Up; no root hint
scenario.observed: No subfolders guidance and Up visible; root hint absent

scenario.action: Delete task-owned empty Unavailable fixture after root listing, then enter it
scenario.expected: Browse error and Back; no false root hint
scenario.observed: Server no such directory error; Back visible; no root hint/link

scenario.action: Change disposable Default browse folder via Settings to Empty; reopen picker; restore setting
scenario.expected: Empty root retains explanation and empty-folder guidance
scenario.observed: Both messages visible, no Up; original fixture root restored

scenario.action: Delay browse response5s through a task-only loopback QA proxy
scenario.expected: Loading with no false root hint; hint appears on successful response
scenario.observed: Loading screenshot has no hint; after response the root hint appears

scenario.action: Return a controlled403 browse response through the QA proxy
scenario.expected: Permission error, Privacy Settings and retry controls; no root hint
scenario.observed: Controlled permission message, existing privacy/retry guidance, root hint absent

notes: Scenarios1–7 exercised the code at e26d8594; subsequent commits change only the issue plan. Scenarios8–9 exercised the identical source at final499072df.
Loading/403 were controlled network conditions using a task-specific loopback proxy, not a real OS permission denial.
Add-agent-account caller source-inspected, not separately browser-driven; dark theme exercised.
Native ref midpoint landed between wrapped link lines; direct mouse text click and keyboard Enter both navigated successfully.
No QA approval labels granted. Native full validation has reproduced baseline Windows failures, with green supported-platform CI accepted by parent.
